head_commit.message:
ci: set PYTHONPATH=src in publish workflow test job

The publish workflow was failing on the test job because it ran
`python -m unittest discover -s tests` without setting the PYTHONPATH,
leading to ModuleNotFoundError for cquarry. The main CI workflow already
does this correctly.

This mirrors the CI test setup in the publish action to fix the PyPI
publishing failure.

head_commit.message:
cquarry 1.9.0: clear_identifier + custom-column #label/display-name lookup parity

clear_identifier(book_id, id_type) deletes one identifiers pair and
queues OPF resync via _touch_book(); type normalization matches
set_identifier exactly; an absent pair is an honest no-op. Motivated by
the 2026-09-02 phase-3 import, where scrubbing mobi-asin junk needed
raw SQL because the explicit helper was missing.

find_custom_column(key) resolves one custom-columns record by #label,
bare label, or display name: a leading # matches the label only (never
ambiguous); otherwise exact display name wins (the historical key, so
every existing caller keeps working) with bare label as the fallback;
label side case-insensitive like the write module's
_custom_column_meta. load_custom_column routes through it; its
not-found error lists name and #label per column. get_custom_columns
stays keyed by display name (consumers iterate it).

Suite 241 -> 245. Consumer postures recorded in the roadmap: Hermitage
verified + pin bump in 1.7.1; Bindery uv.lock rides Stage 3's 0.24.0;
the fork's editable venv sees 1.9.0 with nothing observable; the
CalibreQuarry verb/flag pass rides 3.26.0.

head_commit.message:
Write-side expansion: entity setters, comments, custom columns, formats, remove_book; 1.5.0

Phase 6 write-side expansion completes the sanctioned mutation surface:
- set_authors/set_series/set_publisher/set_rating/set_languages: NOCASE
  entity resolution, author_sort recomputation, series_index handling,
  UNIQUE(rating) dedup, language canonicalization via search's lang map.
- set_comments: 1:1 upsert/clear on UNIQUE(book).
- set_custom_column: layout auto-detection (Pattern A/B), enum validation
  against display.enum_values, tristate bools, editable/composite guards.
- add_format/remove_format/set_has_cover: data-row registration.
- remove_book: PRAGMA-detected custom-column cleanup (both patterns),
  dirtied-queue cleaning, cascade trigger, orphan pruning.

New read API get_format_stats() for per-format disk usage.
Verified end-to-end against a real user_version-27 library (which caught
the normalized-value-table bug in remove_book).

head_commit.message:
Read-side batch 2: entity columns, display config, preferences, grouped search, annotations location; 1.4.0

Phase 6 read-side gaps, second batch:
- Book rows carry author_sorts/author_links parallel arrays; get_entities(kind)
  exposes {id,name,sort,link,count} for authors/series/publishers/tags/languages.
- get_custom_columns() gains editable/normalized/display JSON.
- Typed preferences accessor: get_preference/get_field_metadata/
  get_grouped_search_terms/get_user_categories/get_tag_browser_state.
- Search engine resolves GroupName:query per upstream grouped-search semantics
  (union, false-inversion, recursion guard) via an optional provider hook.
- New annotations: location over concatenated searchable_text (all text match
  kinds + true/false presence); documented deviation vs upstream FTS.
